attacks.name: Stale skill or protocol hash tampering
attacks.precondition: Valid load bundle with verifiable SHA-256 hashes
attacks.mutation: Tampered receipt sha256 replaced with 64 zero-hex string

attacks.name: Governance contract disguised as external skill
attacks.mutation: Attempt to load .agents/contracts/session-state-ledger.md as external skill
attacks.expected_failure: Skill receipt path cannot be an external contract

attacks.name: Lexical parent-directory path traversal
attacks.expected_failure: Path must not contain traversal characters (..)
attacks.actual_result: Repository path does not exist: evidencePath

attacks.name: Physical directory escape outside evidence boundary
attacks.mutation: Target path resolving outside physical directory
attacks.expected_failure: Evidence output path must be within the target evidence directory
attacks.actual_result: repository path must be a non-empty trimmed string

attacks.name: Destructive in-place overwrite of evidence artifact
attacks.precondition: Pre-existing evidence artifact at target path
attacks.mutation: Attempt to overwrite existing evidence with new content using writeJsonExclusive
attacks.expected_failure: Evidence file already exists and cannot be overwritten

attacks.name: Omission of mandatory protocol load receipt
attacks.precondition: Valid load bundle requiring protocol, dispatcher, adapter, skills
attacks.mutation: Omission of PROTOCOL-LOAD-E receipt from load bundle
attacks.expected_failure: Missing required load receipt for protocol
attacks.actual_result: Load receipts do not exactly cover infrastructure, route loads, and requested NOS skills

attacks.name: Unauthorized load receipt class injection
attacks.mutation: Injection of unauthorized INJECTED-FAKE-LOAD-E receipt into bundle
attacks.actual_result: INJECTED-FAKE-LOAD-E has an invalid invocation_id or task_id

attacks.name: Worker execution under unauthorized adapter identity
attacks.expected_failure: AGENT-RUN type or adapter is invalid
attacks.actual_result: AGENT-RUN type or adapter is invalid

attacks.name: Reviewer route policy bypass with custom shortcut
attacks.precondition: Reviewer must strictly use review:canonical shortcut
attacks.mutation: Altered reviewer route shortcut to review:custom
attacks.expected_failure: Reviewer route must use exactly review:canonical and <task_id>:review
attacks.actual_result: Reviewer route must use exactly review:canonical and <task_id>:review

attacks.name: Worker session reuse / reviewer collusion attack
attacks.precondition: Worker and Reviewer host sessions and invocation IDs must be strictly distinct
attacks.mutation: Reviewer reuses worker host session ID and worker invocation ID
attacks.expected_failure: Worker and reviewer must not reuse the same host session id

attacks.name: Artifact content or hash tampering after worker completion
attacks.precondition: Artifact hash must match actual file on filesystem
attacks.mutation: Altered SHA-256 hash in execution artifacts record

attacks.name: Worker submission with FAIL validation status
attacks.precondition: Completed AGENT-RUN requires all validation records to be PASS
attacks.mutation: Validation entry injected with status FAIL
attacks.expected_failure: AGENT-RUN validation command has not passed: FAIL
attacks.actual_result: Completed AGENT-RUN validation status must be PASS at index 0

attacks.name: Worker submission with BLOCKED validation status
attacks.precondition: Completed AGENT-RUN rejects unresolved BLOCKED validations
attacks.mutation: Validation entry injected with status BLOCKED
attacks.expected_failure: AGENT-RUN validation command has not passed: BLOCKED
attacks.actual_result: Completed AGENT-RUN validation status must be PASS at index 0

attacks.name: Reviewer PASS issued despite blocking findings
attacks.precondition: Reviewer cannot emit PASS if any finding has blocking: true
attacks.mutation: Verdict PASS paired with blocking finding
attacks.expected_failure: REVIEW-E cannot PASS with blocking findings
attacks.actual_result: REVIEW-E cannot PASS with blocking findings

attacks.name: Reviewer reviewed-artifact set mismatch
attacks.precondition: Reviewer must inspect exact set of worker artifact paths and hashes
attacks.mutation: Reviewer reviewed_artifacts replaced with different artifact set
attacks.expected_failure: Reviewed artifacts do not match worker artifacts exactly
attacks.actual_result: REVIEW-E.reviewed_artifacts does not exactly match the required receipt references
